work.handOverAsk.lead: Its agent asks to hand this session over to another agent.
work.handOverAsk.claim: Its note for the next agent, its own claim:
work.handOverAsk.waits: It would go on with {{agent}} in the same tree, told Daoris’s record of this session and this note. Nothing goes until you say yes.
work.handOverAsk.approved: You said yes: it goes on with {{agent}} at the driver’s next look, once its turn has ended.
work.handOverAsk.unread: Daoris reads it at its next look, by your rule for hand-overs.
work.handOverAsk.declined: Not handed over: the session stays with its agent, and its timeline says you said no.
work.handOverAsk.refused.gone: This session holds no such ask any more.
work.handOverAsk.refused.past: It is past your word: taken or refused already.
work.handOverAsk.refused.unread: Daoris has not read it yet: say no once it waits on your word.
work.handOverAsk.refused.approved: It has your yes already, and goes at the driver’s next look.
work.handOverAsk.refused.cannot: The hand-over could not be taken: the session’s timeline says why.
